I believe that MC;CBUG > compiles incorrectly.  Specifically
the "(BOUNDP FILE-FORK)" where FILE-FORK is an argument gets
compiled into:
HLRZ 1,@- 6(14)
HRRZ 1,0(1)
HRRZ 1,0(1)
CAIN 1,QUNBOU

There is too much indirection here for me.  You get memory protection
violations here depending upon whFILE-FORK contains.

I meant MC:JOHAN;CBUG >
johan
